title: Reconfirm: Stage & Close Ownership - Helix Health sprint
text:
Reconfirm: Stage & Close Ownership - Helix Health sprint

["From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>\\nTo: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>\\nCc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>\\nDate: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 08:12:00 -0700\\nSubject: Reconfirm: Stage & Close Ownership - Helix Health sprint\\n\\nTeam —\\n\\nAttached is a quick export of Helix Health opportunities that look either stale (no activity in 30+ days) or have close dates more than 90 days past expected delivery. Finance is asking for a one-time ownership sprint so we can reconcile the Sept forecast. Please do the following by COB Thursday (9/16):\\n\\n- Review the attached CSV and confirm each row: update Stage to the correct stage, adjust Close Date or mark as Forecast Not Realistic (FNR), or set Archive if truly dead.\\n- For any deal you move to Commit, add a one-line rationale in the SF Opportunity Notes and paste the HubSpot record link.\\n- If you need more time or want me to escalate to CS for customer-facing blockers, reply with the short reason.\\n\\nI'm trying to avoid an across-the-board downward adjustment from Finance. Small asks but important for forecast integrity. I will consolidate changes Friday morning and pull a new forecast snapshot.\\n\\nAttachment: 20260914-helix-stale-opps.csv (CSV: opp_id,owner,stage,close_date,last_touch,amount)\\n\\nThanks —\\nKarthik\\nDirector, Enterprise Sales Ops\\nRedwood Inference\\n", 'From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>\\nTo: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>\\nCc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>\\nDate: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 09:03:00 -0700\\nSubject: Re: Reconfirm: Stage & Close Ownership - Helix Health sprint\\n\\nOn Tue, Sep 14, 2026 at 8:12 AM Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai> wrote:\\n> Team —\\n> \\n> Attached is a quick export of Helix Health opportunities that look either stale (no activity in 30+ days) or have close dates more than 90 days past expected delivery. Finance is asking for a one-time ownership sprint so we can reconcile the Sept forecast. Please do the following by COB Thursday (9/16):\\n> \\n> - Review the attached CSV and confirm each row: update Stage to the correct stage, adjust Close Date or mark as Forecast Not Realistic (FNR), or set Archive if truly dead.\\n\\nThanks, Karthik — got it. I ran a quick pass and flagged 6 rows as archive candidates (no response to 3 POC emails + budget delayed). I can update Stage -> Closed Lost with a 1-line reason and archive the others. For the two big deals (Opp 5892 and 5920) I need to confirm procurement timing — I’ll ping the buyer today and update close date if they confirm Oct deployment.\\n\\nPlan: finalize SF updates by Thursday EOD and add the one-line rationale per opp. If I hit procurement blockers I’ll hit up Marissa to coordinate the CS touch.\\n\\n—Ben\\nAccount Executive, Strategic Sales\\nRedwood Inference\\n', 'From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>\\nTo: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>\\nDate: Thu, 16 Sep 2026 07:45:00 -0700\\nSubject: Re: Reconfirm: Stage & Close Ownership - Helix Health sprint\\n\\nBen —\\nQuick note from ops: when you update Stage -> Closed Lost, please add Loss Reason = "No Budget / De-prioritized" and set Last Touch to the date of your last meaningful contact. That helps Finance with churn attribution.\\n\\nAlso when marking FNR, please set Probability = 10% and add tag "FNR-2026-Sep" on the record so we can filter for the month-end export.\\n\\nI pulled the HubSpot link for Opp 5920: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/HLX-5920 — if you update the close date, drop a short comment so I know to include it in the revised forecast CSV.\\n\\n—Neha\\nSales Operations Manager\\nRedwood Inference\\n', 'From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>\\nTo: Oliver Stone <oliver@helixhealth.com>\\nCc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, procurement <contracting@helixhealth.com>\\nDate: Fri, 17 Sep 2026 11:22:00 -0700\\nSubject: Quick check-in: Helix Health pipeline snapshot (internal hygiene)\\n\\nHi Oliver —\\nLooping you in briefly: Ben and our ops team are running a short internal hygiene sprint to confirm open opportunities and delivery timing so our finance team can finalize September numbers. This is internal to Redwood — no action required from you unless the projected close timing we have is inaccurate.\\n\\nIf anything has shifted on your side for the expected Oct POC or procurement timing, can you reply with the new ETA? If not, we’ll assume the Oct deployment window stands and we’ll reflect that in our internal close-date update.\\n\\nThanks for the quick read. If helpful I can send a short readout after we reconcile.\\n\\nBest,\\nKarthik\\nDirector, Enterprise Sales Ops\\nRedwood Inference\\n', 'From: Oliver Stone <oliver@helixhealth.com>\\nTo: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>\\nDate: Fri, 17 Sep 2026 14:45:00 -0700\\nSubject: Re: Quick check-in: Helix Health pipeline snapshot (internal hygiene)\\n\\nKarthik —\\nThanks for the heads up. Procurement has pushed the PO review to the week of Oct 11 due to internal legal scheduling. The Oct POC still looks likely but the contract decision is now mid-Oct. Please keep Oct as the target but note likely close date slip to 2026-10-15 in your system.\\n\\nOliver\\nDirector of Technical Ops\\nHelix Health']
